scope_correction.permission: the MIT declaration of the robomimic_datasets repository card at revision 74fa0184 covers that repository's objects; it is not extended to the Stanford-hosted object; permission for the Stanford object is unresolved, not refused: an applicable rights-holder declaration covering that release could establish it without making the releases identical
scope_correction.infeasibility: only the specific route of binding the repository declaration to the Stanford object by byte identity is closed; no other lawful route was tested

new_finding.control: normalization-batch-control-001.json (command 9037c020, no dataset, no simulator, zero optimizer updates)
new_finding.observed: robomimic 0.3.0 ObsUtils.normalize_obs asserts len(mean.shape) - len(obs.shape) in [0, 1] and mean.shape[diff:] == obs.shape; postprocess_batch_for_training therefore raises 'shape length mismatch in @normalize_obs' for every BC-RNN sequence batch (batch sizes 100, 2 and 1) and 'shape mismatch' for any non-sequence batch larger than one; the rollout-shaped inputs (D,) and (1, D) pass
new_finding.consequence: with the held implementation, hdf5_normalize_obs true cannot train the BC-RNN family: the first optimizer update would fail in postprocessing; a normalized inference checkpoint cannot be produced without a declared correction of the training-time normalization function
new_finding.smallest_concrete_amendment: a harness-level override of ObsUtils.normalize_obs used only during training that computes (x - mean) / std with mean and std of shape (1, D) broadcast over any leading batch and time dimensions, elementwise identical on the shapes (D,) and (1, D) that the unchanged rollout path uses; declared as a substituted boundary, digest-bound, and checked by a four-shape equality control before the run; the dataset-side statistics computation and the inference path stay unchanged
